name: Duo Security - Outliers and Threat Analysis
description: See outliers, and threat analysis of Duo Events
title: Duo Security - Outliers and Threat Analysis

panels.title: Threat Intel Analysis of Authentication Events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  authentication 
| json field=_raw "eventtype" as eventtype nodrop  
| where eventtype = "authentication"
| json field=_raw "result" as result nodrop
| json field=_raw "access_device.ip" as ip nodrop
| json field=_raw "access_device.location.city" as city nodrop
| json field=_raw "access_device.location.country" as country nodrop
| json field=_raw "access_device.location.state" as state nodrop
| json field=_raw "application.name" as application_name nodrop
| json field=_raw "factor" as factor nodrop
| json field=_raw "reason" as reason nodrop
| json field=_raw "result" as result nodrop
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as time nodrop
| time* 1000 as timemilli
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timemilli)), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| json field=_raw "user.name" as user_name nodrop

| where !isNull(ip)
| threatlookup singleIndicator ip

// normalize confidence level to a string 
| if (_threatlookup.confidence >= 85, "high", if (_threatlookup.confidence >= 50, "medium", if (_threatlookup.confidence >= 15, "low", if (_threatlookup.confidence >= 0, "unverified", "unknown")))) as threat_confidence

| where threat_confidence in ("high", "medium", "low")

//rename to match threat_<foo> convention
| %"_threatlookup.actors" as threat_actors
| %"_threatlookup.type" as type
| %"_threatlookup.threat_type" as threat_type

//convert threat valid from to human readable time
| toLong(%"_threatlookup.valid_from" * 1000) as %"_threatlookup.valid_from"
| formatDate(%"_threatlookup.valid_from", "MM-dd-yyyy") as threat_valid_from

| where type matches "ipv4-addr*" and !isNull(threat_confidence)

| if (isEmpty(threat_actors), "Unassigned", threat_actors) as threat_actors

| where if ("{{user_name}}" = "*", true, user_name matches "{{user_name}}") AND if ("{{ip}}" = "*", true, ip matches "{{ip}}")
| count by date_time, ip, eventtype, result, city, application_name, factor, reason, user_name,threat_actors, threat_type,type,threat_valid_from

panels.title: Threat Intel Analysis of Admin Events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  administrator  
| json field=_raw "eventtype" as eventtype nodrop   
| where eventtype = "administrator" 
| json field=_raw "action" as action nodrop
| json field=_raw "object" as object nodrop
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as time nodrop
| time* 1000 as timemilli
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timemilli)), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| json field=_raw "username" as user_name nodrop
| json field=_raw "description" as description nodrop
| json field=description "ip_address" as ip_address nodrop

| where !isNull(ip_address)
| threatlookup singleIndicator ip_address

// normalize confidence level to a string 
| if (_threatlookup.confidence >= 85, "high", if (_threatlookup.confidence >= 50, "medium", if (_threatlookup.confidence >= 15, "low", if (_threatlookup.confidence >= 0, "unverified", "unknown")))) as threat_confidence

| where threat_confidence in ("high", "medium", "low")

//rename to match threat_<foo> convention
| %"_threatlookup.actors" as threat_actors
| %"_threatlookup.type" as type
| %"_threatlookup.threat_type" as threat_type

//convert threat valid from to human readable time
| toLong(%"_threatlookup.valid_from" * 1000) as %"_threatlookup.valid_from"
| formatDate(%"_threatlookup.valid_from", "MM-dd-yyyy") as threat_valid_from

| where type matches "ipv4-addr*" and !isNull(threat_confidence)

| if (isEmpty(threat_actors), "Unassigned", threat_actors) as threat_actors

| if(isnull(object),"none", object) as object
| where if ("{{user_name}}" = "*", true, user_name matches "{{user_name}}")
| count by date_time, ip_address, action, object, user_name, description,threat_actors, threat_type,type,threat_valid_from
